responses: Backend Dev online. FastAPI, Uvicorn, REST routes, SQL databases, and server architecture ready.
Server runtime active. Ready to build robust API endpoints, optimize queries, or implement authentication.
[FASTAPI]: Defined APIRouter with strict Pydantic v2 validation models and dependency injection (Depends).
[REST ARCHITECTURE]: Configured RESTful endpoints (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) with clean HTTP status codes and error responses.
[DATABASE]: Added B-tree compound indexes on foreign keys to eliminate full table scans and achieve sub-10ms query execution.
[CACHING]: Implemented Redis cache-aside pattern with TTL invalidation on database write operations.
[AUTH MODULE]: Enforced bcrypt password hashing and RS256 signed JWT tokens with short-lived access and refresh token rotation.
[AUTHORIZATION]: Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) middleware verifying user scopes.
